- Provide default codecs config callback to custom codecs [#24118](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24118)
- Add protobuf MessageConverter [#24087](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24087)
- Refine Throwable handling in spring-websocket [#24075](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24075)
- Improve part content type determination in MockMultipartHttpServletRequest [#24074](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24074)
- Cache result of String.getBytes() in ExtendedBeanInfo.PropertyDescriptorComparator [#24072](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24072)
- Use String.isEmpty() instead of String.equals("") [#24052](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24052)
- IOException "Closed while Pending/Unready" with WebFlux on Jetty [#24050](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24050)
- Avoid substring allocation in StringUtils.replace [#24023](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24023)
- Use `@MessageMapping` method signature to constrain RSocket interaction model [#23999](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23999)
- Avoid indefinite wait to connect in JettyWebSocketClient [#23994](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23994)
- Add queryParam method to MockHttpServletRequestBuilder [#23980](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23980)
- Fallback locale other than the system locale in AbstractResourceBasedMessageSource [#23977](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23977)
- Support for new MySQL 8 error code 3572 [#23972](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23972)
- Simplify ConstructorResolver: do not sort intermediate array [#23969](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23969)
- Avoid store all beanName in ApplicationListenerDetector [#23965](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23965)
- Allow ExchangeStrategies customizations in WebClient [#23961](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23961)
- Use Method::getParameterCount where possible [#23949](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23949)
- Align implementations of StringToUUIDConverter and UUIDEditor [#23940](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23940)
- Use "non-blocking" thread for server-less tests in WebTestClient [#23936](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23936)
- Avoid default Accept header from HttpUrlConnection in RestTemplate with put and delete #23740 [#23855](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23855)
- Reject "%2F" as an invalid sequence in simp messaging usernames [#23836](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23836)
- ApplicationListenerMethodAdapter: gracefully handle beans which are actually NullBean [#23784](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23784)
- Provide orNull extensions for WebFlux ServerRequest [#23761](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23761)
- MockMvc Kotlin DSL should support async dispatch [#23758](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23758)
- RSocketRequestSpec handling metadata values that is a Publisher type [#23640](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23640)
- Preserve the originalMessage when creating an ErrorMessage in MessageBuilder [#23417](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23417)
- Add an option to not include Charset in the final http request ContentType Header [#22971](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22971)
- Allow sending headers with the disconnect frame [#22715](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22715)
- Avoid String concatenation for lookup in StaticMessageSource [#22451](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22451)
- Keys for form data in FormHttpMessageConverter must not be null [#22372](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22372)
-  XpathResultMatcher supports Hamcrest Matcher NodeList [#2023](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/2023)
- Error details in RestTemplate client and server exceptions [#1956](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/1956)
- Preserve "type" parameter in media type for Atom Feed/Entry message conversion [#1885](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/1885)

## :beetle: Bug fixes

- Null pointer when connecting to RSocket [#24088](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24088)
- Regression: `@Inherited` annotations declared in superclass are not recognized anymore [#24077](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24077)
- RSocketRequester allows specifying data more than once [#24073](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24073)
- Revise AbstractBeanDefinition equals implementation [#24048](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24048)
- SqlRowSet accessor methods should be marked `@Nullable` [#24042](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24042)
- Unsafe invocation of .value() on annotations in SynthesizedMergedAnnotationInvocationHandler prevents backwards-compatible additions to annotations [#24029](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24029)
- InMemoryWebSessionStore makes blocking calls to UUID.randomUUID [#24027](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24027)
- ControllerAdviceBean.findAnnotatedBeans() finds proxies as well as their target beans, resulting in double registration [#24017](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24017)
- NullPointerException in JSON codec parsing stream encoded with Jackson Smile [#24009](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24009)
- Fix inappropriate eager init. [#23992](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23992)
- Calling MethodParameter.isOptional() for Kotlin Continuation parameter fails with IndexOutOfBoundsException [#23991](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23991)
- Regression: ControllerAdviceBean#getOrder() causes BeanCreationException for request scoped advice beans [#23985](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23985)
- TestDispatcherServlet ambiguous handler methods with consumes condition and body not required [#23978](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23978)
- AbstractRequestLoggingFilter.getHeaderPredicate is accidentally public [#23976](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23976)
- Reading 'null' JSON response via WebClient fails in v5.2.x [#23935](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23935)
- Allow schemaZip Gradle task to execute on MS Windows [#23933](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23933)
- Regression: AnnotationUtils.findAnnotation no longer finds non-inherited "java." annotations on superclasses [#23929](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23929)
- ResponseCookie to allow leading dot in domain name again [#23924](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23924)
- Regression in spring-test's 5.2.1 MockCookie parse implementation [#23911](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23911)
- useSuffixPatternMatch ignored if pathPrefix is also used [#23907](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23907)
- Ensure InstantFormatter can properly deserialize ISO-formatted dates [#23895](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23895)
- Fix RSocket Fire and forget handling with Kotlin [#23866](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23866)
- SpEL cannot invoke Kotlin synthetic classes [#23812](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23812)
- ShallowETagHeaderFilter overwrites ETag [#23775](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23775)
- Corrupted multipart + correct content-length lead to `Flux<Part>` hanging [#23768](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23768)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- [*.*] is displayed as [bold .] ,need to escape [#24108](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24108)
- Fix consecutive-word duplications in documentation [#24089](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24089)
- Examples in Data Access chapter declare unused JdbcTemplate fields [#24085](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24085)
- Data Access chapter 3.5.1 uses bad pattern [#24084](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24084)
- Documentation flaw for `<tx:method/>` settings [#24080](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24080)
- Fix errors in documentation [#24008](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24008)
- TypeDescriptor#getElementTypeDescriptor does not throw IllegalStateException anymore [#23996](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23996)
- Update docs on ShallowEtagHeaderFilter with regards to ASYNC dispatches [#23958](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23958)
- DEFAULT_PHASE of SmartLifecycle interface has incorrect Javadoc [#23956](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23956)
- Documentation for ForwardedHeaderFilter does not mention important filter order [#23954](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23954)
- Different behavior when injecting beans from local `@Configuration` class vs. external `@Configuration` classes [#23934](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23934)
- Correct Javadoc for WebMvcConfigurer#addInterceptors [#23922](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23922)
- Improve WebClient.Builder::filter documentation [#23342](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23342)

## :hammer: Dependency upgrades

- Upgrade to Reactor Dysprosium-SR2 [#24037](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24037)
- Upgrade to Kotlin 1.3.61 [#24006](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24006)

- Invalid partial content requests possible with start byte = resource-byte-count [#23576](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23576)
- Support invoking static methods with ReflectionTestUtils.invokeMethod() [#23504](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23504)
- Detect ClientHttpConnector to use by checking classpath [#23493](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23493)
- Remove statusCode state from ContentCachingResponseWrapper [#23490](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23490)
- Fix "array index out of bounds" problem reported by LGTM.com [#23485](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23485)
- Explicit attribute overrides configured via `@AliasFor` not supported for components picked up via component scanning [#23402](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23402)
- Provide a way to predict bean types without initializing FactoryBeans [#23374](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23374)
- Pre-allocate NoTransactionException in TransactionContextManager [#23360](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23360)
- Use System.nanoTime() instead of System.currentTimeMillis() in StopWatch [#23235](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23235)
- Correct encoding and decoding of "message/x.rsocket.routing.v0" [#23137](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23137)
- Add support for Coroutines transactions  [#22915](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22915)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- Cannot use relative path following placeholder in `@TestPropertySource` locations [#23544](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23544)
- Spring Webflux 5.2.0.M2 - Kotlin coroutines - ServerRequest.awaitPrincipal always null [#22986](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22986)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Fix typos related to indefinite articles [#23555](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23555)
- Adding Kotlin code examples to Testing documentation. [#23545](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23545)
- Add `@since` for getCacheFilter and setCacheFilter [#23519](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23519)
- Wiki build instructions for local Maven repo are outdated [#23517](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23517)
- Fix unmatched parenthesis in the documentation of ContextHierarchy [#23487](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23487)
- Modify the javadoc of `@EnableWebFlux` annotation [#23457](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23457)
- Kotlin examples in Spring Core docs should use extension functions with reified types [#23456](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23456)
- Improve language-switch CSS [#23454](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23454)
- Fix data access documentation typo [#23450](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23450)
- Fix */* in Javadoc [#23439](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23439)
- Reference documentation for ContextClosedEvent is misleading [#23436](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23436)
- Reference documentation for `@Autowired`'s required attribute is misleading [#23428](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23428)
- Provide code samples in Kotlin in addition to Java [SPR-17245] [#21778](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21778)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to Reactor Dysprosium-RC1 [#23579](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23579)

- Upgrade to Kotlin Coroutines 1.3.0 [#23535](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23535)
- Upgrade to CGLIB 3.3 [#23453](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23453)

- Deprecate mutable aspects of MethodParameter [#23385](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23385)
- Add status code 425 ("Too Early") to HttpStatus enum [#23384](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23384)
- Search for annotations on enclosing classes with MergedAnnotations API [#23378](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23378)
- RSocketRequester.Builder support for ConnectionSetupPayload [#23368](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23368)
- Introduce SimpleUrlHandlerMapping constructor that accepts an order and a Map  [#23362](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23362)
- Introduce interface cache for proxied EntityManager and Query types [#23345](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23345)
- Provide functionality similar to Spring Boot's BeanTypeRegistry [#23341](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23341)
- Add attribute support for FactoryBean bean definitions [#23339](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23339)
- Consider generics when predicting FactoryBean types [#23338](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23338)
- Cache isFactoryBean detection [#23337](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23337)
- Retain merged bean definition caches during post processing [#23336](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23336)
- Add missing ResolvableType variants of getBeanNamesForType [#23335](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23335)
- Add multi-prefix comment support for `@SqlConfig` [#23331](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23331)
- Support `@TestPropertySource` as a repeatable annotation [#23320](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23320)
- Add DataBuffer::toString(Charset) [#23317](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23317)
- Improvements to RSocketStrategies [#23314](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23314)
- Support for template routes with encoded separator in RSocketRequester [#23310](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23310)
- Treat null path as non-matching pattern in AntPathMatcher [#23297](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23297)
- Add multi-prefix comment support for SQL scripts [#23289](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23289)
- Add a ScriptEngine factory to ScriptTemplateConfigurer [#23258](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23258)
- Log at WARN level in case of contradicting PersistenceUnitManager setup [#23257](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23257)
- ExchangeFilterFunctions.basicAuthentication(String, String) should cache the encoded credentials [#23256](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23256)
- Introduce TransactionOperations.execute(Runnable) convenience method [#23250](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23250)
- ExceptionHandlerExceptionResolver warns when re-throwing the exception cause [#23233](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23233)
- Change `@TestConstructor`.autowire attribute into an enum [#23224](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23224)
- Improve performance of FormContentFilter [#23216](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23216)
- MimeTypeUtils.parseMimeType returns null MIME type in case of high concurrency [#23211](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23211)
- Add explicit support for multipart/mixed in FormHttpMessageConverter [#23209](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23209)
- AbstractMessageConverterMethodProcessor results in 406 even when ResponseEntity presets content type [#23205](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23205)
- BasicAuthenticationInterceptor should cache the encoded credentials [#23204](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23204)
- Introduce addSupportedMediaTypes() in FormHttpMessageConverter [#23203](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23203)
- Add no-op TransactionOperations implementation [#23198](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23198)
- `@CacheEvict` beforeInvocation with transaction does not work [#23192](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23192)
- Presort beans in ControllerAdviceBean.findAnnotatedBeans() [#23188](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23188)
- Consider generics on ApplicationListener `@Bean` methods [#23178](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23178)
- ConnectionMapping annotation for handling of RSocket connection-level frames [#23177](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23177)
- Support for registering handlers in RSocketRequester.Builder  [#23170](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23170)
- Leverage new Kotlin script templating support [#23165](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23165)
- Improve RSocketRequester.ResponseSpec Kotlin extensions [#23164](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23164)
- Support Ordered interface for `@ControllerAdvice` beans [#23163](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23163)
- Support multipart/related and multipart/mixed MediaTypes in RestTemplate [#23159](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23159)
- RSocket Metadata Mimetype "text/plain" and "application/json" support [#23157](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23157)
- onStatus throws away default status handler [#23155](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23155)
- Forbid null HttpMessageConverter in RestTemplate and HttpMessageConverterExtractor [#23151](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23151)
- Support target type in MockMvcResultMatchers.jsonPath() [#23141](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23141)
- UrlBasedViewResolvers should not override custom requestContextAttribute with null [#23129](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23129)
- Add queryParams and replaceQueryParams with Collection to UriBuilder [#23119](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23119)
- Provide functionality similar to Spring Boot's BeanTypeRegistry [#23056](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23056)
- Expose default error handling from RequestHeadersSpec::retrieve for use with RequestHeadersSpec::exchange [#22825](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22825)
- Use the accepted profiles on the BeanDefinitionDsl [#22393](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22393)
- Consider conditional view caching [#22391](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22391)
- WebClient's ResponseSpec should provide access to response headers [#22368](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22368)
- Support for non-blocking event listener methods [SPR-17298] [#21831](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21831)
- Merge class-level and method-level `@Sql` declarations [#1835](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/1835)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- `@TransactionalEventListener` should not receive an event if no transaction is active [#23276](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23276)
- MockMvc no longer handles UTF-8 characters [#23219](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23219)
- NullPointerException when FormContentFilter handles a request with no content type [#23215](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23215)
- RSocketRequester.ResponseSpec Kotlin extensions issue [#23185](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23185)
- PathPattern::extractPathWithinPattern does not use custom separator [#23168](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23168)
- PathPatternRouteMatcher should parse routes with custom separator [#23167](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23167)
- DefaultMultipartMessageReader.FilePartPart.content not available under Reactor Netty [#23131](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23131)
- DefaultMultipartMessageReader.FilePart.transferTo fails occasionally  [#23130](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23130)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Fix grammar in package-info.java [#23401](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23401)
- Add since tag for ClientResponse.Builder.request() [#23364](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23364)
- Fix typo in data-access.adoc [#23247](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23247)
- Fix typo in CONTRIBUTING.md [#23180](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23180)
- Document supported `@Transactional` attributes in the TestContext framework [#23149](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23149)
- Document WebFlux FreeMarker macro support in Reference Manual [#23133](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23133)
- Add since for JettyClientHttpConnector change [#23128](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23128)
- Improve Kotlin integration testing documentation [#22875](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22875)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to RSocket 1.0.0-RC2 [#23359](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23359)
- Upgrade to ASM 7.2 [#23156](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23156)
- Upgrade to JUnit Jupiter 5.5 [#23076](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23076)

- WebClient's retrieve doesn't support custom HTTP status code  [#23367](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23367)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- ResolvableType.forRawClass fails isAssignable against TypeVariable [#23321](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23321)
- ForwardedHeaderTransformer preserves escape sequences when applying X-Forwarded-Prefix [#23305](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23305)
- Accept header with trailing comma produces HTTP "406 Not Acceptable" [#23241](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23241)
- FlashMapManager throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException for empty target URL path [#23240](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23240)
- SpEL ReflectivePropertyAccessor: ConversionService missing annotations on concrete implementations [#23210](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23210)
- Defensively register ReactiveReturnValueHandler for messaging methods [#23207](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23207)

- WebSocketHttpRequestHandler not writing headers after interceptor returns false [#23179](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23179)
- Reliable detection of user change from interceptor in StompSubProtocolHandler [#23160](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23160)
- Fixes issue with optional `@RequestPart` Mono argument being resolved to null instead of Mono.empty [#23070](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23070)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Add Javadoc since for Jaxb2XmlDecoder(MimeType...) [#23353](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23353)
- Fix typo in webflux.adoc [#23329](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23329)
- Clarify use of MultipartBodyBuilder with RestTemplate [#23295](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23295)
- Improve documentation for `@Autowired` constructors [#23263](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23263)
- AbstractCacheManager.getCache() breaks contract of CacheManager.getCache() [#23193](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23193)

- messageBrokerTaskScheduler incorrect type [#22943](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22943)

- Enable use of PathPattern for RSocket routing [#22642](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22642)

- @DestinationVariable not working with RSocket support [#22776](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22776)
- Consistent non-exposure of inherited annotations in AnnotationMetadata [#22766](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22766)
- Introduce publishEvent() convenience method in TestContext [#22765](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22765)
- Add support to query if ApplicationContext is available in the TestContext framework [#22756](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22756)
- Use more efficient Reactor operators [#22727](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22727)
- Spring logging support enhancement [#22726](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22726)
- Primary resolution against FactoryBean instances [#22711](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22711)
- Expose Jaxb2Marshaller createMarshaller() and createUnmarshaller() methods [#22708](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22708)
- WebClient option with both URI template and UriBuilder [#22705](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22705)
- Track when isLazyInit has been set in AbstractBeanDefinition [#22694](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22694)
- Infer null-safety from type variables in Kotlin extensions when possible [#22687](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22687)
- RequestCondition optimizations [#22644](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22644)
- Custom WebFlux encoders/decoders are placed below defaults [#22612](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22612)
- JtaTransactionManager created with the JtaTransactionManagerFactoryBean is not ready to use [#22605](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22605)
- Avoid calling other bean methods in web config [#22596](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22596)
- Allow usage of BeanNameGenerator in ImportBeanDefinitionRegistrars [#22591](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22591)
- Add public getDeclaredMethods method to ReflectionUtils [#22580](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22580)
- Cache BridgeMethodResolver results [#22579](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22579)
- Optimize StringUtils.cleanPath [#22568](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22568)
- Use less memory and try to skip more classes when processing @Configuration classes [#22563](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22563)
- Enhance support for java.time types in spring-web [#22546](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22546)
- Migrate CacheControl to use java.time.Duration for durations [#22545](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22545)
- @RequestMapping without any attributes behaves as "default endpoint" [#22543](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22543)
- BeanFactory.get*ForAnnotation should take @Bean metadata into account [#22541](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22541)
- Revisit BeanUtils.instantiateClass to work consistently with Kotlin and Java classes [#22531](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22531)
- Use String::isEmpty instead of "".equals(arg) when arg is not null [#22502](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22502)
- CorsUtils#isCorsRequest should detect same origin requests with an Origin header [#22496](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22496)
- "java.lang.IllegalStateException: Only one connection receive subscriber allowed." is masking real exceptions in WebFlux. [#22486](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22486)
- Exclude jdk package in ShadowingClassLoader [#22485](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22485)
- Provide support for publishing test execution life-cycle events [#22477](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22477)
- Clarify configuration lite support and offer an opt-in option [#22461](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22461)
- CorsInterceptor should add to the first interceptor in InterceptorChain? [#22459](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22459)
- SpringFactoriesLoader.instantiateFactory(…) should report offending class on error [#22453](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22453)
- Minimise need to iterate over a class's methods [#22420](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22420)
- Some very simple improvements regarding usage of ArrayList [#22418](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22418)
- Extract duplicated code into a separate method [#22404](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22404)
- Simplify ConcurrentReferenceHashMap [#22387](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22387)
- MappingJackson2MessageConverter doesn't check if payload assignable to target type [#22386](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22386)
- WebClient filters should be deferred to the subscription time [#22375](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22375)
- Added configurable maxFramePayloadLength to ReactorNettyWebSocketClient [#22367](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22367)
- Avoid MimeType garbage creation [#22340](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22340)
- Use AtomicInteger instead of unsafe increment on volatile fields [#22278](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22278)
- DefaultCorsProcessor does not set "vary: Origin" if the request has no Cors header [#22273](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22273)

- Use Method in CglibAopProxy.fixedInterceptorMap instead of String returned from Method::toString [#22258](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22258)
- Add option for AbstractRequestLoggingFilter to blacklist certain headers [#22244](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22244)
- Limit ref() and provider() visibility in Kotlin DSL [SPR-17648] [#22177](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22177)
- Improve message for `HttpStatusCodeException` with empty status text [#22162](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22162)

- Add bean definition attribute for ConfigurationClassPostProcessor to skip "lite" bean detection [SPR-17412] [#21945](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21945)
- MapMethodArgumentResolver precludes custom argument resolvers with Map and custom annotation [SPR-17340] [#21874](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21874)
- Correctly parse property name in path "map[key[foo]]" [#21855](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/21855)
- Bean registration with Kotlin DSL using callable reference with autowired parameters  [SPR-17312] [#21845](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21845)
- MockRestServiceServer.verify() not working in a CompletableFuture [SPR-17266] [#21799](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21799)
- Create replacement API for handling merged annotations [SPR-17161] [#21697](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21697)
- Use parameters declared in consumes or produces condition to narrow the request mapping [SPR-17133] [#21670](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21670)
- Introduce Servlet version HandlerFunction and RouterFunction [SPR-16952] [#21490](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21490)
- RSocket client and server support [SPR-16751] [#21292](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21292)
- Incorrect return type of Kotlin suspending functions [SPR-16515] [#21058](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21058)
- Let Spring show the URL mappings for @MessageMapping in startup process [SPR-16015] [#20564](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20564)
- Allow transaction control via Vavr Try type [SPR-15806] [#20361](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20361)
- Add support for Kotlin coroutines [SPR-15413] [#19975](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/19975)
- Publish test execution events to the test ApplicationContext [SPR-13916] [#18490](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18490)
- toString for AbstractSqlParameterSource [#2080](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/2080)
- Open parameter autowiring utility for external use [#2060](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/2060)
- Add Kotlin DSL for working with MockMvc [#1951](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/1951)

- Initial GraalVM native images (Substrate VM) support [SPR-16991] [#21529](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21529)
- SchedulerFactoryBean should not override explicit "org.quartz.scheduler.instanceName" setting with bean name [SPR-16884] [#21423](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21423)
- DataBufferUtils does not release DataBuffer on error cases [SPR-16782] [#21322](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21322)

- JUnit Jupiter `@Nested` class cannot share enclosing class's ApplicationContext if nested class is deemed to be a configuration candidate [SPR-16595] [#21136](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21136)

:star: New Features

- Task "docsZip" copies duplicate reference files [SPR-16789] [#21329](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21329)

- WebFlux handles requests with an illegal Host header inconsistently [SPR-16778] [#21318](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21318)
- Implement ReactorNettyWebSocketSession.close [SPR-16774] [#21314](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21314)
- Prevent unnecessary ExchangeStrategies.withDefaults() in DefaultWebClientBuilder [SPR-16771] [#21311](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21311)
- Improve performance of StringUtils#trimWhitespace method [SPR-16766] [#21307](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21307)
- Validate contextPath in RedirectView [SPR-16752] [#21293](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21293)
- No support for non-standard HTTP status codes in reactive ClientHttpResponse [SPR-16748] [#21289](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21289)
- Expose configuration options for "selector" header  [SPR-16732] [#21273](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21273)
- Flag misguided evaluation attempts in OperatorMatches [SPR-16731] [#21272](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21272)
- Avoid repeated superclass introspection in AnnotationUtils.findAnnotation [SPR-16730] [#21271](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21271)
- SynchronossPartGenerator should reuse PartBodyStreamStorageFactory [SPR-16727] [#21268](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21268)
- AbstractMessageReaderArgumentResolver.readBody should defer creating the error [SPR-16726] [#21267](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21267)
- Revise JCA MessageEndpoint exception logging and propagation [SPR-16717] [#21258](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21258)
- Revise cache safety check to avoid performance regression in EAR packaged applications on WildFly [SPR-16714] [#21255](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21255)
- Add a default constructor to Reactive UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource [SPR-16712] [#21253](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21253)

- Reduce log verbosity on server-side after client unsubscribes from SSE stream [SPR-16688] [#21229](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21229)
- Kotlin unable to inherit type for WebTestClient#BodySpec [SPR-15692] [#20251](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20251)

:star: New Features

- Add cpp to mime.types as text/plain [SPR-16678] [#21219](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21219)
- Mixed use BeanNameAutoProxyCreator and AnnotationAwareAspectJAutoProxyCreator to proxy same bean [SPR-16677] [#21218](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21218)
- Comprehensively cache annotated methods for interfaces and superclasses [SPR-16675] [#21216](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21216)
- Reduce ClassUtils.forName overhead (in particular for annotation introspection purposes) [SPR-16667] [#21208](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21208)
- Generate multipart boundary using SecureRandom  [SPR-16635] [#21176](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21176)
- When `@DependsOn` throws a NoSuchBeanDefinitionException it should include the dependent bean for clarity [SPR-16628] [#21169](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21169)
- STOMP broker relay only allows up to 15 client connections [SPR-16626] [#21167](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21167)
- Update ContentNegotiationStrategy to never return an empty List [SPR-16624] [#21165](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21165)
- Allow to make FormHttpMessageConverter add the charset in the Content-Type header [SPR-16613] [#21154](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21154)
- ThreadPoolTaskExecutor should cancel all remaining Future handles on shutdown [SPR-16607] [#21148](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21148)
- CodecException: No suitable writer found for part [SPR-16601] [#21142](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21142)
- Consistent volatile access to running flag in Lifecycle implementations [SPR-16596] [#21137](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21137)
- Support for grouped DeferredImportSelector [SPR-16589] [#21131](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21131)
- Support for SimpleEvaluationContext in SpEL [SPR-16588] [#21130](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21130)
- MockMvcResultMatchers.jsonPath(String).value() should have a matching method to declare the expected type [SPR-16587] [#21129](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21129)
- Consider caching interface-derived BeanInfo instances in CachedIntrospectionResults [SPR-16568] [#21110](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21110)
- Support `@ResponseStatus-annotated` exceptions on WebFlux [SPR-16567] [#21109](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21109)
- Overloaded convenience setters on HttpHeaders [SPR-16562] [#21104](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21104)
- Consistent incrementer arrangement for PostgreSQL, DB2 and SAP HANA [SPR-16558] [#21101](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21101)
- Provide simple way to create ClientResponse [SPR-16553] [#21096](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21096)
- Improve docs and handling of send errors in ResponseBodyEmitter [SPR-16548] [#21091](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21091)
- EncoderHttpMessageWriter never sets Content-Length [SPR-16542] [#21085](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21085)
- Jackson Encoder(s) ignore charset in MimeType [SPR-16539] [#21082](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21082)
- Need ability to access URI template in WebClient metrics/tracing instrumentation [SPR-16537] [#21080](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21080)
- DefaultMessageListenerContainer should interrupt worker threads when not returning on shutdown [SPR-16536] [#21079](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21079)
- Support for ResolvableType.getType().getTypeName() on Java 8 [SPR-16535] [#21078](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21078)
- Consistent use of Collection.toArray with zero-sized array argument [SPR-16523] [#21066](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21066)
- Unable to register `@RestControllerAdvice` Class via WebTestClient [SPR-16520] [#21063](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21063)
- Headers adding ability in ACK/NACK frame [SPR-16519] [#21062](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21062)
- SSE writer does not allow customizing the charset [SPR-16516] [#21059](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21059)
- Customize PreparedStatementCreatorFactory in getPreparedStatementCreator [SPR-16050] [#20599](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20599)
- Support BufferingClientHttpRequestFactory in MockRestServiceServer  [SPR-14694] [#19258](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/19258)
- Add support for asserting JSON in ContentRequestMatchers, just as there is for XML [SPR-13919] [#18493](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18493)
- Spring Websockets Broker relay supporting a cluster of STOMP endpoint addresses [SPR-12452] [#17057](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17057)

- SimpleMailMessage's handling of to/cc/bcc arrays is inconsistent [SPR-16671] [#21212](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21212)

- An error occurs if a blank character exists before and after the delimiter of the MIME type parameter. [SPR-16630] [#21171](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21171)
- Address race condition within spring that causes about-to-be-created-bean exceptions [SPR-16627] [#21168](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21168)
- FactoryBeanRegistrySupport atomicity issues [SPR-16625] [#21166](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21166)
- Consistent thread-safe iteration in DefaultSingletonBeanRegistry [SPR-16620] [#21161](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21161)

- ResourceDecoder incorrectly matches to Object.class [SPR-16606] [#21147](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21147)

- Lambda-based consumption of an ObjectProvider's object when available [SPR-16001] [#20550](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20550)

- Get a description of all registered routes in a RouterFunction [SPR-15711] [#20268](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20268)

- Provide hierarchy traversal support for getBeanNamesForAnnotation [SPR-15923] [#20477](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20477)

- Provide hook in DefaultWebSessionManager to support creating custom WebSession implementation [SPR-15876] [#20431](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20431)
- Immutable object constructor arguments not considering WebDataBinder's FIELD_MARKER_PREFIX [SPR-15871] [#20426](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20426)
- Add support for Kotlin autowired constructor with optional parameters [SPR-15847] [#20402](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20402)
- BeanDefinitionBuilder method arguments not annotated with `@Nullable` [SPR-15841] [#20396](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20396)
- MockMvc doesn't honor params in RequestMapping when no equal sign [SPR-15831] [#20386](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20386)
- Autowire contract is not honored in cases where FactoryBean or `@Bean` return null [SPR-15829] [#20384](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20384)
- WebClientException should allow access to status code of the response [SPR-15824] [#20379](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20379)
- URI variables with MockRestRequestMatchers's requestTo [SPR-15819] [#20374](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20374)
- Use ParameterizedTypeReference instead of Class in Kotlin extensions [SPR-15818] [#20373](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20373)
- Add ParameterizedTypeReference method variants to ServerRequest/ServerResponse [SPR-15817] [#20372](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20372)
- Avoid requiring it lambda parameter in Kotlin bean DSL [SPR-15815] [#20370](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20370)
- Media type fails to match types with multiple '+' characters [SPR-15795] [#20350](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20350)
- Support range requests for Spring MVC request mapped methods that return a Resource [SPR-15789] [#20344](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20344)
- ExchangeFilterFunctions Explicit Model For Basic Authentication Credentials [SPR-15764] [#20319](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20319)
- BindingResult support for constructor argument mismatch on immutable data object [SPR-15542] [#20101](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20101)
- Leveraging kotlin-reflect to determine interface method parameters [SPR-15541] [#20100](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20100)
- Consistent overriding for all variants of init/destroy method inheritance [SPR-15532] [#20091](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20091)

- Placeholder resolution for annotation attributes is not active by default [SPR-14140] [#18712](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18712)
- Add method to TestPropertySourceUtils to add properties files directly to the environment [SPR-14131] [#18703](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18703)
- Improve MimeTypeUtils to handle the case of only a delimiter passed [SPR-14124] [#18696](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18696)
- Unable to define empty java.util.Optional bean in spring xml [SPR-14121] [#18693](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18693)
- Possibility to configure a custom WebJarAssetLocator [SPR-14092] [#18664](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18664)
- Proper load-time weaving support for Hibernate 5 [SPR-13886] [#18459](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18459)
- AbstractAdvisorAutoProxyCreator should consistently detect package-visible methods [SPR-14174] [#17890](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17890)
- `@Scheduled` methods in `@Lazy` beans are not scheduled [SPR-12872] [#17470](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17470)

- ScheduledAnnotationBeanPostProcessor should unregister tasks on destruction of individual beans [SPR-12216] [#16830](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16830)

- Method lookup doesn't allow for overriding definitions in parent bean [SPR-13388] [#17969](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17969)

- Log connection URL for embedded databases [SPR-13370] [#17954](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17954)
- Add 'preparer-factory' attribute to <mvc:tiles-configurer/> [SPR-13363] [#17947](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17947)
- Add Jdk7Module to Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder's well known modules [SPR-13354] [#17938](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17938)
- Introduce JsonPath matchers for empty and non-empty content [SPR-13352] [#17936](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17936)
- Avoid ambiguous property warning for setter methods with multiple parameters [SPR-13349] [#17933](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17933)
- Revisit RedirectView's use of getCurrentWebApplicationContext() [SPR-13346] [#17930](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17930)
- Support implicit attribute aliases with `@AliasFor` [SPR-13345] [#17929](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17929)
- Introduce SmartMessageConverter interface with conversionHint arguments [SPR-13343] [#17927](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17927)
- StompSubProtocolHandler should send SessionSubscribeEvent after ChannelSecurityInterceptor has validated access rights [SPR-13339] [#17924](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17924)
- Provide a SpringConstraintValidatorFactory variant for use with validation.xml [SPR-13327] [#17912](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17912)
- BeanPropertyRowMapper should log if mapRow doesn't find a PropertyDescriptor [SPR-13323] [#17908](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17908)
- Introduce additional JsonPath matchers in Spring MVC Test [SPR-13320] [#17905](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17905)
- File upload with Servlet 3 multipart requests should support filename with charset encoding (RFC 2231) [SPR-13319] [#17904](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17904)
- Deprecate JdkVersion (for optimistic compatibility with newer JDK generations) [SPR-13312] [#17897](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17897)
- UriComponents should support URI variables that contain a regex [SPR-13311] [#17896](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17896)
- HibernateJpaDialect should warn about connection release mode other than ON_CLOSE (when upgrading from 4.0.x) [SPR-13269] [#17860](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17860)
- Support for JSR-356 WebSockets on WebSphere Liberty Profile [SPR-12367] [#16973](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16973)

:star: New Features

- ResourceBundleMessageSource performance optimization for getStringOrNull [SPR-13295] [#17885](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17885)
- Unable to override RequestMappingHandlerAdapter#createRequestMappingMethod [SPR-13293] [#17883](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17883)
- Introduce 'value' alias for 'attribute' in `@AliasFor` [SPR-13289] [#17879](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17879)
- RequestMapping: case insensitive path matching [SPR-13286] [#17876](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17876)
- Support `@Rollback` at the class level [SPR-13276] [#17867](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17867)
- DispatcherServlet: enable applyDefaultViewName to access multipart request parameters [SPR-13272] [#17863](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17863)
- `@MessageMapping` with placeholders [SPR-13271] [#17862](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17862)
- InvocableHandlerMethod.getMethodArgumentValues() failure should lead to warn-level logging by default [SPR-13267] [#17858](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17858)
- Jackson `@JsonView` deserialization support for `@MessageMapping` payloads [SPR-13265] [#17856](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17856)
- Add a new ResultMatcher for date formats in HTTP headers [SPR-13263] [#17854](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17854)
- RFC 3986: UriComponentsBuilder.fromUriString should support empty URIs [SPR-13257] [#17848](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17848)
- SockJS client does not use HttpHeaders passed by WebSocketConnectionManager for ServerInfo request [SPR-13254] [#17845](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17845)
- AsyncAnnotationBeanPostProcessor could find TaskExecutor by type/name [SPR-13248] [#17839](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17839)
- Make AbstractFallbackTransactionAttributeSource.computeTransactionAttribute(…) protected [SPR-13246] [#17837](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17837)
- Inconsistent JPA behavior using no transaction, propagation SUPPORTS and OpenEntityManager pattern [SPR-13243] [#17834](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17834)
- Transaction propagation SUPPORTS leads to “HHH000326: Cannot join transaction” warning [SPR-13242] [#17833](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17833)
- AllEncompassingFormHttpMessageConverter does not prefer Jackson2 over JAXB for XML marshalling [SPR-13240] [#17831](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17831)
- ScheduledAnnotationBeanPostProcessor should fall back to default TaskScheduler by name [SPR-13236] [#17827](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17827)
- Add MockMvc HtmlUnit Integration [SPR-13158] [#17749](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17749)
- Introduce `@Commit` alias for `@Rollback`(false) [SPR-13279] [#17372](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17372)
- MockHttpServletResponse.setDateHeader does not perform date formatting [SPR-11912] [#16531](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16531)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- onCompletion SseEmitter callback never gets called [SPR-13292] [#17882](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17882)
- Regression in 4.2: NPE due to WebJarsResourceResolver [SPR-13291] [#17881](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17881)
- MockMvc.perform with the TestContext framework causes additional perform invocations to be "polluted" [SPR-13260] [#17851](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17851)
- Reset Pragma header in WebContentGenerator when caching resources [SPR-13252] [#17843](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17843)
- PropertyOrFieldReference throws ClassCastException [SPR-13247] [#17838](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17838)
- PathResourceResolver should not resolve "/" as a JAR resource [SPR-13241] [#17832](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17832)
- Regression: AnnotationScopeMetadataResolver fails to resolve VaadinView [SPR-13239] [#17830](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17830)
- Regression in ResponseStatusExceptionResolver: setStatus versus sendError [SPR-13226] [#17817](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17817)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Doc: Autowiring in `@Configuration` classes with post-processor definitions [SPR-13285] [#17875](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17875)
- Document changes about HTTP cache header defaults in migration docs [SPR-13253] [#17844](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17844)
- AOP section referencs outdated resources [SPR-13238] [#17829](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17829)
- Document SpringClassRule and SpringMethodRule in the reference manual [SPR-13037] [#17629](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17629)
- Document AopTestUtils in the reference manual [SPR-13006] [#17598](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17598)
- Document support for generating unique names for embedded databases in the reference manual [SPR-12839] [#17437](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17437)

- TomcatInstrumentableClassLoader should support Tomcat 7.0.63+ as well [SPR-13210] [#17802](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17802)
- ResourceBundleThemeSource could expose the property fallbackToSystemLocale of ResourceBundleMessageSource [SPR-13209] [#17801](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17801)
- Make RedirectViews use RESPONSE_STATUS_ATTRIBUTE as a response status if defined [SPR-13208] [#17800](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17800)
- Avoid rejecting same origin requests detected as CORS requests [SPR-13206] [#17798](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17798)
- LinkedMultiValueMap should allow for deep copy of List values [SPR-13201] [#17793](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17793)
- CommonsMultipartResolver should support setFileSizeMax [SPR-13200] [#17792](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17792)
- Support HandlerMethod parameter in `@MessageExceptionHandler` [SPR-13196] [#17788](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17788)
- Add an Access-Control-Request-Method check for CORS preflight requests [SPR-13193] [#17785](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17785)
- Add a CORS Filter [SPR-13192] [#17784](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17784)
- DelegatingFilterProxy should be aware of FrameworkServlet's WebApplicationContext [SPR-13191] [#17783](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17783)
- Unresolvable class in 'basePackageClasses' annotation attribute results in misleading and hard to diagnose error [SPR-13177] [#17769](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17769)
- Add `@EventListener` value() support for event class literals [SPR-13156] [#17747](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17747)
- ScriptTemplateView configuration option for JavaScript concurrency issues [SPR-13034] [#17626](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17626)
- Reduce BeanDefinition cloning in AbstractBeanFactory.getMergedBeanDefinition [SPR-12236] [#16851](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16851)
- MultipartFile interface should extend InputStreamSource [SPR-11861] [#16480](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16480)

:star: New Features

- Avoid reading (empty) RequestBody for HTTP methods that aren't expected to have a body [SPR-13176] [#17768](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17768)
- Introduce logging support for MvcResult details in the Spring MVC Test framework [SPR-13171] [#17762](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17762)
- Print cookies in human-readable form in Spring MVC Test [SPR-13168] [#17759](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17759)
- Allow MVC handler methods to return any CharSequence type as view name [SPR-13165] [#17756](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17756)
- Support inlined statements in `@Sql` in the TestContext framework [SPR-13159] [#17750](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17750)
- Allow multiple destination per `@JmsListener` [SPR-13147] [#17738](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17738)
- Add an easy way to configure custom StompSubProtocolErrorHandler for StompSubProtocolHandler. [SPR-13142] [#17733](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17733)
- Support for Jetty 9.3 [SPR-13140] [#17731](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17731)
- Status 406 "Not Accepted" is not appropriate when no message converter can handle return type [SPR-13135] [#17726](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17726)
- Allow body of JmsListener annotated method to define returned Message Destination [SPR-13133] [#17724](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17724)
- Support CompletableFuture<> as return type of `@Async` methods [SPR-13128] [#17719](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17719)
- HttpComponentsAsyncClientHttpRequestFactory overrides default request config of httpclient [SPR-13125] [#17716](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17716)
- 400 Bad Request for missing URI template variable is incorrect [SPR-13121] [#17712](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17712)
- Introduce general purpose isEmpty() method in ObjectUtils [SPR-13119] [#17710](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17710)
- Add request timeout to ResponseBodyEmitter [SPR-13104] [#17695](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17695)
- Improve circular import exception, in particular for `@Import` vs import through nesting [SPR-13101] [#17692](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17692)
- Spring does not log deserialization / marshalling errors to the console [SPR-13100] [#17691](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17691)
- Prevent class/classloader retention in GenericConversionService [SPR-13099] [#17690](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17690)
- Reduce memory consumption for caches [SPR-13093] [#17684](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17684)
- Allow annotation to be synthesized from a map with minimal attributes [SPR-13087] [#17678](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17678)
- Transaction Scope [SPR-13085] [#17676](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17676)
- Custom async HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler should work with `@ResponseBody`  [SPR-13083] [#17674](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17674)
- Introduce synthesized annotation alternative to getAnnotationAttributes() in AnnotatedElementUtils [SPR-13082] [#17673](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17673)
- Performing an asyncDispatch with MockMvc fails if DeferredResult is not yet set [SPR-13079] [#17670](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17670)
- AsyncResult implementation does not allow for throwing ExecutionException [SPR-13076] [#17668](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17668)
- Support retrieval of nested annotations in AnnotationAttributes [SPR-13074] [#17666](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17666)
- Document public API in AnnotationAttributes [SPR-13072] [#17664](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17664)
- Improve generics matching of ApplicationEvent subtypes with generic payload parameter [SPR-13069] [#17661](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17661)
- Introduce support for synthesizing AnnotationAttributes into an annotation [SPR-13067] [#17659](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17659)
- CORS global configuration support in XML namespace [SPR-13046] [#17638](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17638)
- Base64 support option without Commons Codec dependency on Java 6/7 [SPR-12938] [#17531](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17531)
- Make `@ResponseBody` method return type available to message converters [SPR-12811] [#17408](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17408)
- Maintain original ordering of active profiles in the TestContext framework [SPR-12492] [#17098](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17098)
- UriComponentsBuilder#fromHttpRequest should consider RFC-7239 Forwarded headers [SPR-11856] [#16475](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16475)
- Introduce a comprehensive programming model for meta-annotation support [SPR-11511] [#16136](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16136)
- Introduce aliases for 'value' annotation attributes [SPR-11393] [#16020](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16020)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- Type aware canWrite() method should be called for GenericHttpMessageConverter [SPR-13161] [#17752](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17752)
- MimeType must use case insensitive comparisons for Charsets [SPR-13157] [#17748](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17748)
- Stomp version 1.1 and 1.2 allows headers with empty values [SPR-13111] [#17702](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17702)
- Fix combining class and method level `@CrossOrigin` attributes [SPR-13097] [#17688](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17688)

- ServletWebRequest.checkNotModified(…) writes Last-Modified header in invalid format [SPR-13090] [#17681](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17681)
- AnnotationUtils.getRepeatableAnnotation() swallows AnnotationConfigurationException [SPR-13084] [#17675](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17675)
- Server Sent Events use "event" as the type prefix [SPR-13080] [#17671](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17671)
- Nested arrays of annotations are synthesized with wrong component type [SPR-13077] [#17669](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17669)
- AnnotationUtils breaks contract for `@Repeatable` annotations [SPR-13068] [#17660](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17660)
- XpathResultMatchers ignores character encoding of XML document [SPR-12676] [#17275](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17275)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Documentation definition for ConditionalGenericConverter not the same as the source definition [SPR-13071] [#17663](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17663)
