- Customize STOMP ERROR frame [SPR-12732] [#17329](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17329)
- Add TimeoutException to JmsInvokerClientInterceptor [SPR-12731] [#17328](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17328)
- MessageConverter implementation that marshals from/to XML [SPR-12726] [#17323](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17323)
- All HttpMessageConverters should support StreamingHttpOutputMessage [SPR-12715] [#17312](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17312)
- ResolvableType.getType() should reflect the set up type correctly [SPR-12701] [#17298](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17298)
- Support global `@MessageExceptionHandler` [SPR-12696] [#17293](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17293)
- Cache aspect should also clear expression caches on shutdown [SPR-12691] [#17289](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17289)
- Improve extensibility of TestContext bootstrap and context caching mechanisms [SPR-12683] [#17282](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17282)
- Make resolveContextLoader() method in AbstractTestContextBootstrapper protected [SPR-12682] [#17281](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17281)
- Improve charset parsing in MockHttpServletRequest and Response [SPR-12677] [#17276](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17276)
- Unable to explicitly order WebRequestInterceptors via addInterceptors method [SPR-12673] [#17272](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17272)
- ResourceBundleMessageSource should allow for custom PropertyResourceBundle subclass [SPR-12666] [#17265](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17265)
- context register `@Configuration` doesn't respect `@Order`  [SPR-12657] [#17257](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17257)
- Add support for `@Lazy` on `@Resource` injection points [SPR-12654] [#17255](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17255)
- TransactionAwareCacheDecorator method clear not synchronised with transaction [SPR-12653] [#17254](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17254)
- Support for java.util.Optional as a `@RequestPart` [SPR-12644] [#17245](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17245)
- `@Order` should get detected in case of proxyTargetClass=false as well [SPR-12636] [#17237](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17237)
- Provide reusable parts of Cache implementation for others [SPR-12622] [#17223](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17223)
- Configuration of path mapping options for websockets via XML [SPR-12621] [#17222](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17222)
- task:annotation-driven does not process exception-handler with mode aspectj [SPR-12619] [#17220](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17220)
- Allow customizing "base" path in MvcUriComponentsBuilder (e.g. path prefix for locale) [SPR-12617] [#17218](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17218)
- Allow readTimeout / connectTimeout in Netty4ClientHttpRequestFactory [SPR-12612] [#17213](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17213)
- Document how HandlerInterceptor should differentiate an ASYNC dispatch  [SPR-12608] [#17209](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17209)
- Provide access to the target HandlerMethod from `@ExceptionHandler` methods [SPR-12605] [#17206](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17206)
- Explicit failure if multiple `@BootstrapWith` annotations are used on the same test [SPR-12602] [#17203](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17203)
- Log warning for Isolation.READ_UNCOMMITTED with Propagation.NOT_SUPPORTED [SPR-12600] [#17201](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17201)
- Support CompletableFuture as alternative to DeferredResult in MVC [SPR-12597] [#17198](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17198)
- Support Jackson `@JsonFilter` [SPR-12586] [#17187](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17187)
- Merge default request config with local customizations [SPR-12583] [#17184](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17184)
- Flash attributes not working with spaces in query parameters [SPR-12569] [#17170](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17170)
- Support for apache commons-pool2 [SPR-12532] [#17137](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17137)
- Make BeanWrapperImpl use BeanUtils [SPR-12520] [#17125](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17125)
- Jackson `@JsonView` deserialization support for request bodies [SPR-12501] [#17106](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17106)
- Support for Undertow 1.2 / WildFly 9.0 [SPR-12469] [#17075](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17075)
- Support org.springframework.context.ApplicationContextInitializer usage programmatically (in Servlet 3.0+ environments) [SPR-12430] [#17036](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17036)
- Introduce BEFORE_METHOD and BEFORE_CLASS modes for `@DirtiesContext` [SPR-12429] [#17035](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17035)
- Support `@Order` on ApplicationListeners [SPR-12410] [#17018](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17018)
- ResourceHttpRequestHandler serves all files with must-revalidate cache header, should not do that when using a content versioning strategy [SPR-12562] [#16988](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16988)
- Two trailing slashes and the default servlet cannot resolve to a controller [SPR-12372] [#16979](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16979)
- Make use of response encoding when HTML escaping the default [SPR-12369] [#16976](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16976)
- Ability to use webjar with spring without specifying version info in HTML/jsp file [SPR-12323] [#16928](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16928)
- Custom `@RequestMapping` annotations [SPR-12296] [#16901](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16901)
- Support JavaScript Templating [SPR-12266] [#16871](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16871)
- HTTP Streaming and Server-Sent Events (SSE) [SPR-12212] [#16826](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16826)
- Support for JSR-354 Money & Currency [SPR-12209] [#16823](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16823)
- Support CompletableFuture as return value in `@MessageMapping` handlers [SPR-12207] [#16821](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16821)
- DirectFieldAccessor should support collections [SPR-12206] [#16820](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16820)
- Default conversion from and to java.util.stream.Stream [SPR-12175] [#16789](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16789)
- Support destination variable placeholders in `@SendTo` and `@SendToUser` for STOMP endpoints [SPR-12170] [#16784](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16784)
- Support ListenableFuture as return value in `@MessageMapping` handlers [SPR-12168] [#16782](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16782)
- Add generics / parameterized type support to ListableBeanFactory getBeanNamesForType/getBeansOfType methods [SPR-12147] [#16761](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16761)
- ShallowEtagHeaderFilter should use a more efficiently dynamically resizing buffer than ResizableByteArrayOutputStream [SPR-12081] [#16697](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16697)
- Add support for transaction bound application events [SPR-12080] [#16696](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16696)
- Expose information about STOMP/WebSocket connections and subscriptions [SPR-12029] [#16645](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16645)
- StringUtils.commaDelimitedListToSet and removeDuplicateStrings should preserve original order [SPR-12003] [#16619](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16619)
- Improve HTTP support and update with new HTTP RFCs [SPR-11886] [#16505](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16505)
- Support standard javax.transaction.Transactional in AspectJ [SPR-11803] [#16423](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16423)
- Server-side HTTP caching improvements [SPR-11792] [#16413](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16413)
- SpEL should not restrict 'NEW' identificator as 'new' token for constructor [SPR-11783] [#16405](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16405)
- Java based config should support class-only component declarations through `@Import` [SPR-11740] [#16362](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16362)
- Support for Hibernate ORM 5.0 [SPR-11694] [#16316](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16316)
- Within Cache abstraction, log when a value was found for a key, and when not. [SPR-11654] [#16277](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16277)
- ApplicationListener-like annotation for consuming application events [SPR-11622] [#16245](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16245)
- Support user destinations with multiple WebSocket servers [SPR-11620] [#16243](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16243)
- Favor more locally declared composed annotations over inherited annotations [SPR-11598] [#16221](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16221)
- STOMP client support [SPR-11588] [#16212](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16212)
- Provide public methods to register and un-register handler method mappings [SPR-11541] [#16166](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16166)
- Document and test status quo for AnnotatedElementUtils [SPR-11514] [#16139](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16139)
- Introduce support for explicit annotation attribute overrides [SPR-11513] [#16138](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16138)
- Introduce unified support for declaring and looking up annotation attribute aliases [SPR-11512] [#16137](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16137)
- Heartbeat in Messaging SimpleBroker [SPR-10954] [#15582](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15582)
- `@Bean` on Java 8 default methods in interfaces [SPR-10919] [#15547](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15547)
- Add support for http byte-range requests [SPR-10805] [#15431](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15431)
- TypeMismatchException for `@RequestParam` does not contain parameter name [SPR-10153] [#14786](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/14786)
- ConfigurationClassBeanDefinitionReader.loadBeanDefinitionsForModelMethod should take into account the allowBeanDefinitionOverride settings [SPR-9682] [#14316](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/14316)
- Beans defined by `@ComponentScan` are skipped in `@Configuration` override [SPR-9567] [#14201](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/14201)
- CORS support [SPR-9278] [#13916](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13916)
- Introduce support for generating unique names for embedded databases [SPR-8849] [#13491](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13491)
- ApplicationEvent should take generics into account when dispatching events [SPR-8201] [#12850](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12850)
- AnnotationTransactionAspect retains reference to closed BeanFactory [SPR-7964] [#12619](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12619)
- Provide a formatter registry capability local to a controller [SPR-7773] [#12429](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12429)
- Provide `@Rule` alternative to SpringJUnit4ClassRunner [SPR-7731] [#12387](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12387)
- When a bean definition is overridden, detect whether the definition has changed and log accordingly [SPR-7607] [#12263](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/12263)
- Support for XSSFWorkbook and SXSSFWorkbook (xmlx format; POI 3.9+) [SPR-6898] [#11563](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/11563)
- Support setting and getting static fields in ReflectionTestUtils [SPR-6792] [#11458](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/11458)
- No way to register Formatter instances by field on DataBinder [SPR-6069] [#10737](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/10737)
- ScriptFactory for JSR-223 [SPR-5215] [#9888](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/9888)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- An exception is thrown when validation fails on public nested fields [SPR-13107] [#17698](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17698)
- SynthesizedAnnotation must be public [SPR-13057] [#17649](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17649)
- In SPEL projection expression,  #this as the same value as #root [SPR-13055] [#17647](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17647)
- Wrong URL with MvcUriComponentsBuilder::fromMethodCall in case of inheritance [SPR-13033] [#17625](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17625)
- AntPathMatcher should throw an IllegalArgumentException if patterns cannot be combined [SPR-12998] [#17590](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17590)
- MvcUriComponentsBuilder does not support bridged methods [SPR-12977] [#17568](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17568)
- AnnotatedElementUtils fails to find type-level annotations on interfaces [SPR-12944] [#17537](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17537)
- AnnotationUtils does not support arbitrary levels of meta-annotations on methods [SPR-12941] [#17534](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17534)
- ConfigurationClassEnhancer.enhanceFactoryBean is not transparent for method calls other than getObject() [SPR-12915] [#17514](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17514)
- HttpClientErrorException missing response body if callback is registered [SPR-12887] [#17485](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17485)
- MockHttpServletRequestBuilder should not decode query string [SPR-12880] [#17478](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17478)
- HttpEntity controller method arguments should allow null body [SPR-12861] [#17459](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17459)
- Contract of `@RequestPart`(required=false) not obeyed [SPR-12860] [#17458](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17458)
- BeanFactoryUtils.beanNamesForTypeIncludingAncestors(factory, RepositoryFactoryInformation.class, false, false) doesn't find beans that are found in 4.1 [SPR-12846] [#17444](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17444)
- CompositePropertySource doesn't fulfil EnumerablePropertySource [SPR-12788] [#17385](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17385)
- `@JmsListener` cannot be a scoped proxy [SPR-12774] [#17371](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17371)
- Favor more locally declared composed annotations over inherited annotations in the TestContext framework [SPR-12749] [#17346](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17346)
- AnnotatedElementUtils fails to find annotations on abstract, bridge, or interface methods [SPR-12738] [#17335](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17335)
- ClassCastException in ResponseBodyEmitterReturnValueHandler.supportsReturnType(…) [SPR-12693] [#17291](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17291)
- SpEL Collection Selection: "selectionExpression" with method invocation pushes root object as active context instead of current item [SPR-12035] [#16651](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16651)
- DefaultMessageListenerContainer#doShutdown hangs [SPR-11841] [#16460](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16460)
- Collection selection and the use of #this [SPR-10417] [#15050](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15050)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Add xsd description for default handling of autowire and lazy-init attributes [SPR-13038] [#17630](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17630)
- Improve description of shutting down the IoC container in reference document [SPR-13000] [#17592](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17592)
- Modify typo in the reference document [SPR-12993] [#17585](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17585)
- Remove the RemoteAccountService(sample code for JAX-RPC) from the reference document [SPR-12992] [#17584](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17584)
- OXM exception hierarchy image is not displayed in reference manual [SPR-12990] [#17582](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17582)
- JpaDialect description replace to EclipseLink from TopLink [SPR-12988] [#17579](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17579)
- Remove descriptions of classic API of ORM(JDO/JPA) [SPR-12987] [#17578](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17578)
- Improve description of DefaultLobHandler in reference manual [SPR-12985] [#17576](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17576)
- Bad grammar in reference document [SPR-12981] [#17572](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17572)
- Reference manual should not refer to deprecated ParameterizedBeanPropertyRowMapper [SPR-12980] [#17571](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17571)
- Update documentation for the resultsMapCaseInsensitive flag in JdbcTemplate [SPR-12979] [#17570](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17570)
- Document meta-annotation support in AnnotationUtils [SPR-12940] [#17533](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17533)
- [doc] Update reference for STOMP client [SPR-12814] [#17411](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17411)
- Documentation regression: some TIP and NOTE wrongly displayed [SPR-12791] [#17388](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17388)
- Documentation the limitation of injecting components in `@Configuration` classes [SPR-12773] [#17370](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17370)
- Improve RedirectAttributes reference documentation [SPR-12759] [#17356](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17356)
- Document event infrastructure improvements [SPR-12702] [#17299](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17299)
- Document how to prevent a JNDI DataSource retrieved using JavaConfig to be removed on shutdown of the context [SPR-12551] [#17153](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17153)
- Modularize Asciidoc [SPR-12309] [#16914](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16914)

- Provide default codecs config callback to custom codecs [#24118](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24118)
- Add protobuf MessageConverter [#24087](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24087)
- Refine Throwable handling in spring-websocket [#24075](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24075)
- Improve part content type determination in MockMultipartHttpServletRequest [#24074](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24074)
- Cache result of String.getBytes() in ExtendedBeanInfo.PropertyDescriptorComparator [#24072](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24072)
- Use String.isEmpty() instead of String.equals("") [#24052](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24052)
- IOException "Closed while Pending/Unready" with WebFlux on Jetty [#24050](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24050)
- Avoid substring allocation in StringUtils.replace [#24023](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24023)
- Use `@MessageMapping` method signature to constrain RSocket interaction model [#23999](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23999)
- Avoid indefinite wait to connect in JettyWebSocketClient [#23994](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23994)
- Add queryParam method to MockHttpServletRequestBuilder [#23980](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23980)
- Fallback locale other than the system locale in AbstractResourceBasedMessageSource [#23977](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23977)
- Support for new MySQL 8 error code 3572 [#23972](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23972)
- Simplify ConstructorResolver: do not sort intermediate array [#23969](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23969)
- Avoid store all beanName in ApplicationListenerDetector [#23965](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23965)
- Allow ExchangeStrategies customizations in WebClient [#23961](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23961)
- Use Method::getParameterCount where possible [#23949](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23949)
- Align implementations of StringToUUIDConverter and UUIDEditor [#23940](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23940)
- Use "non-blocking" thread for server-less tests in WebTestClient [#23936](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23936)
- Avoid default Accept header from HttpUrlConnection in RestTemplate with put and delete #23740 [#23855](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23855)
- Reject "%2F" as an invalid sequence in simp messaging usernames [#23836](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23836)
- ApplicationListenerMethodAdapter: gracefully handle beans which are actually NullBean [#23784](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23784)
- Provide orNull extensions for WebFlux ServerRequest [#23761](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23761)
- MockMvc Kotlin DSL should support async dispatch [#23758](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23758)
- RSocketRequestSpec handling metadata values that is a Publisher type [#23640](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23640)
- Preserve the originalMessage when creating an ErrorMessage in MessageBuilder [#23417](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23417)
- Add an option to not include Charset in the final http request ContentType Header [#22971](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22971)
- Allow sending headers with the disconnect frame [#22715](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22715)
- Avoid String concatenation for lookup in StaticMessageSource [#22451](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22451)
- Keys for form data in FormHttpMessageConverter must not be null [#22372](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22372)
-  XpathResultMatcher supports Hamcrest Matcher NodeList [#2023](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/2023)
- Error details in RestTemplate client and server exceptions [#1956](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/1956)
- Preserve "type" parameter in media type for Atom Feed/Entry message conversion [#1885](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/1885)

## :beetle: Bug fixes

- Null pointer when connecting to RSocket [#24088](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24088)
- Regression: `@Inherited` annotations declared in superclass are not recognized anymore [#24077](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24077)
- RSocketRequester allows specifying data more than once [#24073](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24073)
- Revise AbstractBeanDefinition equals implementation [#24048](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24048)
- SqlRowSet accessor methods should be marked `@Nullable` [#24042](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24042)
- Unsafe invocation of .value() on annotations in SynthesizedMergedAnnotationInvocationHandler prevents backwards-compatible additions to annotations [#24029](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24029)
- InMemoryWebSessionStore makes blocking calls to UUID.randomUUID [#24027](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24027)
- ControllerAdviceBean.findAnnotatedBeans() finds proxies as well as their target beans, resulting in double registration [#24017](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24017)
- NullPointerException in JSON codec parsing stream encoded with Jackson Smile [#24009](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24009)
- Fix inappropriate eager init. [#23992](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23992)
- Calling MethodParameter.isOptional() for Kotlin Continuation parameter fails with IndexOutOfBoundsException [#23991](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23991)
- Regression: ControllerAdviceBean#getOrder() causes BeanCreationException for request scoped advice beans [#23985](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23985)
- TestDispatcherServlet ambiguous handler methods with consumes condition and body not required [#23978](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23978)
- AbstractRequestLoggingFilter.getHeaderPredicate is accidentally public [#23976](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23976)
- Reading 'null' JSON response via WebClient fails in v5.2.x [#23935](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23935)
- Allow schemaZip Gradle task to execute on MS Windows [#23933](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23933)
- Regression: AnnotationUtils.findAnnotation no longer finds non-inherited "java." annotations on superclasses [#23929](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23929)
- ResponseCookie to allow leading dot in domain name again [#23924](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23924)
- Regression in spring-test's 5.2.1 MockCookie parse implementation [#23911](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23911)
- useSuffixPatternMatch ignored if pathPrefix is also used [#23907](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23907)
- Ensure InstantFormatter can properly deserialize ISO-formatted dates [#23895](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23895)
- Fix RSocket Fire and forget handling with Kotlin [#23866](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23866)
- SpEL cannot invoke Kotlin synthetic classes [#23812](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23812)
- ShallowETagHeaderFilter overwrites ETag [#23775](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23775)
- Corrupted multipart + correct content-length lead to `Flux<Part>` hanging [#23768](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23768)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- [*.*] is displayed as [bold .] ,need to escape [#24108](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24108)
- Fix consecutive-word duplications in documentation [#24089](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24089)
- Examples in Data Access chapter declare unused JdbcTemplate fields [#24085](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24085)
- Data Access chapter 3.5.1 uses bad pattern [#24084](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24084)
- Documentation flaw for `<tx:method/>` settings [#24080](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24080)
- Fix errors in documentation [#24008](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/24008)
- TypeDescriptor#getElementTypeDescriptor does not throw IllegalStateException anymore [#23996](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23996)
- Update docs on ShallowEtagHeaderFilter with regards to ASYNC dispatches [#23958](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23958)
- DEFAULT_PHASE of SmartLifecycle interface has incorrect Javadoc [#23956](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23956)
- Documentation for ForwardedHeaderFilter does not mention important filter order [#23954](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23954)
- Different behavior when injecting beans from local `@Configuration` class vs. external `@Configuration` classes [#23934](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23934)
- Correct Javadoc for WebMvcConfigurer#addInterceptors [#23922](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23922)
- Improve WebClient.Builder::filter documentation [#23342](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23342)

## :hammer: Dependency upgrades

- Upgrade to Reactor Dysprosium-SR2 [#24037](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24037)

- Revisit `@Configuration`(proxyBeanMethods = false) with qualified injection points [#23887](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23887)
- Fixing NPE in AbstractNamedValueMethodArgumentResolver [#23882](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23882)

- Omit cancellation of transactional Monos in TransactionOperator [#23562](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23562)
- PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver cannot load resources with a '#' in their file name within JARs [#23532](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23532)
- Improve parity between Java and Kotlin router DSL [#23524](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23524)
- Provide an memory efficient alternative to ClientHttpRequestInterceptor [#22002](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22002)

- Correct encoding and decoding of "message/x.rsocket.routing.v0" [#23137](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23137)
- Add support for Coroutines transactions  [#22915](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22915)

- Cannot use relative path following placeholder in `@TestPropertySource` locations [#23544](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23544)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Fix typos related to indefinite articles [#23555](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23555)
- Adding Kotlin code examples to Testing documentation. [#23545](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23545)
- Add `@since` for getCacheFilter and setCacheFilter [#23519](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23519)
- Wiki build instructions for local Maven repo are outdated [#23517](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23517)
- Fix unmatched parenthesis in the documentation of ContextHierarchy [#23487](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23487)
- Modify the javadoc of `@EnableWebFlux` annotation [#23457](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23457)
- Kotlin examples in Spring Core docs should use extension functions with reified types [#23456](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23456)
- Improve language-switch CSS [#23454](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23454)
- Fix data access documentation typo [#23450](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23450)
- Fix */* in Javadoc [#23439](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23439)

- Deprecate mutable aspects of MethodParameter [#23385](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23385)
- Add status code 425 ("Too Early") to HttpStatus enum [#23384](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23384)
- Search for annotations on enclosing classes with MergedAnnotations API [#23378](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23378)
- RSocketRequester.Builder support for ConnectionSetupPayload [#23368](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23368)
- Introduce SimpleUrlHandlerMapping constructor that accepts an order and a Map  [#23362](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23362)
- Introduce interface cache for proxied EntityManager and Query types [#23345](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23345)
- Provide functionality similar to Spring Boot's BeanTypeRegistry [#23341](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23341)
- Add attribute support for FactoryBean bean definitions [#23339](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23339)
- Consider generics when predicting FactoryBean types [#23338](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23338)
- Cache isFactoryBean detection [#23337](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23337)
- Retain merged bean definition caches during post processing [#23336](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23336)
- Add missing ResolvableType variants of getBeanNamesForType [#23335](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23335)
- Add multi-prefix comment support for `@SqlConfig` [#23331](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23331)
- Support `@TestPropertySource` as a repeatable annotation [#23320](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23320)
- Add DataBuffer::toString(Charset) [#23317](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23317)
- Improvements to RSocketStrategies [#23314](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23314)
- Support for template routes with encoded separator in RSocketRequester [#23310](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23310)
- Treat null path as non-matching pattern in AntPathMatcher [#23297](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23297)
- Add multi-prefix comment support for SQL scripts [#23289](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23289)
- Add a ScriptEngine factory to ScriptTemplateConfigurer [#23258](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23258)
- Log at WARN level in case of contradicting PersistenceUnitManager setup [#23257](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23257)
- ExchangeFilterFunctions.basicAuthentication(String, String) should cache the encoded credentials [#23256](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23256)
- Introduce TransactionOperations.execute(Runnable) convenience method [#23250](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23250)
- ExceptionHandlerExceptionResolver warns when re-throwing the exception cause [#23233](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23233)
- Change `@TestConstructor`.autowire attribute into an enum [#23224](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23224)
- Improve performance of FormContentFilter [#23216](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23216)
- MimeTypeUtils.parseMimeType returns null MIME type in case of high concurrency [#23211](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23211)
- Add explicit support for multipart/mixed in FormHttpMessageConverter [#23209](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23209)
- AbstractMessageConverterMethodProcessor results in 406 even when ResponseEntity presets content type [#23205](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23205)
- BasicAuthenticationInterceptor should cache the encoded credentials [#23204](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23204)
- Introduce addSupportedMediaTypes() in FormHttpMessageConverter [#23203](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23203)
- Add no-op TransactionOperations implementation [#23198](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23198)
- `@CacheEvict` beforeInvocation with transaction does not work [#23192](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23192)
- Presort beans in ControllerAdviceBean.findAnnotatedBeans() [#23188](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23188)
- Consider generics on ApplicationListener `@Bean` methods [#23178](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23178)
- ConnectionMapping annotation for handling of RSocket connection-level frames [#23177](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23177)
- Support for registering handlers in RSocketRequester.Builder  [#23170](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23170)
- Leverage new Kotlin script templating support [#23165](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23165)
- Improve RSocketRequester.ResponseSpec Kotlin extensions [#23164](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23164)
- Support Ordered interface for `@ControllerAdvice` beans [#23163](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23163)
- Support multipart/related and multipart/mixed MediaTypes in RestTemplate [#23159](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23159)
- RSocket Metadata Mimetype "text/plain" and "application/json" support [#23157](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23157)
- onStatus throws away default status handler [#23155](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23155)
- Forbid null HttpMessageConverter in RestTemplate and HttpMessageConverterExtractor [#23151](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23151)
- Support target type in MockMvcResultMatchers.jsonPath() [#23141](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23141)
- UrlBasedViewResolvers should not override custom requestContextAttribute with null [#23129](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23129)
- Add queryParams and replaceQueryParams with Collection to UriBuilder [#23119](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23119)
- Provide functionality similar to Spring Boot's BeanTypeRegistry [#23056](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23056)
- Expose default error handling from RequestHeadersSpec::retrieve for use with RequestHeadersSpec::exchange [#22825](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22825)
- Use the accepted profiles on the BeanDefinitionDsl [#22393](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22393)
- Consider conditional view caching [#22391](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22391)
- WebClient's ResponseSpec should provide access to response headers [#22368](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22368)
- Support for non-blocking event listener methods [SPR-17298] [#21831](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21831)
- Merge class-level and method-level `@Sql` declarations [#1835](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/1835)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- `@TransactionalEventListener` should not receive an event if no transaction is active [#23276](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23276)
- MockMvc no longer handles UTF-8 characters [#23219](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23219)
- NullPointerException when FormContentFilter handles a request with no content type [#23215](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23215)
- RSocketRequester.ResponseSpec Kotlin extensions issue [#23185](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23185)
- PathPattern::extractPathWithinPattern does not use custom separator [#23168](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23168)
- PathPatternRouteMatcher should parse routes with custom separator [#23167](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23167)
- DefaultMultipartMessageReader.FilePartPart.content not available under Reactor Netty [#23131](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23131)
- DefaultMultipartMessageReader.FilePart.transferTo fails occasionally  [#23130](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23130)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Fix grammar in package-info.java [#23401](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23401)
- Add since tag for ClientResponse.Builder.request() [#23364](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23364)
- Fix typo in data-access.adoc [#23247](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23247)
- Fix typo in CONTRIBUTING.md [#23180](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23180)
- Document supported `@Transactional` attributes in the TestContext framework [#23149](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23149)
- Document WebFlux FreeMarker macro support in Reference Manual [#23133](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23133)
- Add since for JettyClientHttpConnector change [#23128](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23128)
- Improve Kotlin integration testing documentation [#22875](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22875)

- Upgrade to JUnit Jupiter 5.5 [#23076](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23076)

- Add MultiValueMap.addIfAbsent method [#23111](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23111)
- Allow Printers and Parsers to be registered individually to FormatterRegistry [#23110](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23110)
- Improve FreeMarker macro support in spring-webflux [#23105](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23105)
- Annotate Object#equals parameter with `@Nullable` [#23093](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23093)
- Allow separator configuration in PathPatternParser [#23092](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23092)
- Side effect from ProducesRequestCondition cache with multiple RequestMappingHandlerMapping beans [#23091](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23091)
- Refine Coroutines adapter registration activation [#23087](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23087)
- Rename TransactionSynchronizationManager#currentTransaction to something more meaningful [#23086](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23086)
- Support filename input in MultipartBodyBuilder [#23083](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23083)
- Support consistent ordering of string adapting properties [#23081](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23081)
- Add constants for application/cbor to MediaType [#23042](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23042)
- Avoid unnecessary call to get message type [#23040](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23040)
- Support for fine-grained by-type references in the bean definition model [#23032](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23032)
- RestTemplateXhrTransport fails for a StreamingHttpOutputMessage type request [#23030](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23030)
- Provide utility for writing Properties to a file in a repeatable manner [#23018](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23018)
- Expose StompSubProtocolHandler and StompBrokerRelayMessageHandler metrics [#23015](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23015)
- Ensure access to configured mime types in client-side RSocket requester or responder [#23012](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23012)
- Consistently support CompletionStage/CompletableFuture in ReactiveAdapterRegistry [#23011](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/23011)
- Add FreeMarker macro support in spring-webflux [#23002](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/23002)
- NamedParameterJdbcTemplate: treat Iterable parameters like Collections [#22981](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22981)
- Add JettyClientHttpConnector that accepts a HttpClient instance and a JettyResourceFactory [#22977](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22977)
- Add HttpHeaders.getOrEmpty(…) to avoid clients having to default to an empy list [#22949](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22949)
- messageBrokerTaskScheduler incorrect type [#22943](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22943)
- Support composite metadata in RSocketRequester and MessageHandlerAcceptor [#22798](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22798)
- Add leading slash for path predicate if not present [#22795](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22795)
- Enable use of PathPattern for RSocket routing [#22642](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22642)
- Ensure indexer output is deterministic and repeatable [#22383](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22383)

- MergedAnnotation meta-data support [#22909](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22909)
- Support Publisher<Part> in MultipartBodyBuilder#asyncPart [#22876](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22876)
- Consider adding is*Enabled() methods to LogAccessor [#22862](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22862)
- Add getRoot() to MergedAnnotation [#22818](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22818)
- Expose StompSubProtocolWebSocketHandler metrics [#22807](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22807)
- Create RSocketRequesterBuilder in spring-messaging [#22806](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22806)
- Return value doesn't serialize to JSON when return type is Mono of Interface in WebFlux [#22803](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22803)
- Some trivial optimization in method populateBean() [#22792](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22792)
- Consistently implement decodeToMono by joining buffers first [#22783](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22783)
- Add decodeDataBuffer to Decoder and encodeValue to Encoder [#22782](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22782)
- Add coroutines support to RSocket `@MessageMapping` and RSocketRequester [#22780](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22780)
- Add CBOR codec (single value only) [#22767](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22767)
- Add route(RequestPredicate, HandlerFunction) variant to RouterFunctions builder [#22701](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22701)
- Handle Optional<?> `@RequestParam`() when generating URL using MvcUriComponentsBuilder [#22656](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22656)
- Add reactive transaction support SPI [#22646](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22646)
- Reactive transaction management support [#22590](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22590)
- Support constructor injection without `@Autowired` when using JUnit Jupiter in spring-test [#22286](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22286)
- Add protected methods to resolve the target type for payload arguments [SPR-17503] [#22035](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22035)
- Consumes condition support for optional content [SPR-17478] [#22010](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22010)
- Consistent error handling when streaming with servlet vs reactive stack [SPR-17440] [#21972](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21972)
- Create a WebFilter for ServerWebExchange Reactor Context [SPR-17213] [#21746](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21746)
- Make WebFlux multipart support fully Reactive [SPR-17122] [#21659](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21659)

- Avoid SourceClass creation for annotations that are always ignored [#22750](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22750)
- Avoid expensive assertions in HttpRange [#22742](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22742)
- Avoid exceptions in ReflectionUtils.isObjectMethod(…) [#22730](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22730)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- Fix EncoderHttpMessageWriter.isStreamingMediaType() [#22936](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22936)
- Consistent handling of empty List entries in LinkedMultiValueMap [#22912](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22912)
- Check if null before accessing exception message in webflux InvocableHandlerMethod#logArgumentErrorIfNecessary [#22900](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22900)
- DefaultListableBeanFactory.destroySingleton(s) not thread-safe for manual singletons [#22896](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22896)
- MockHttpServletRequest raises IndexOutOfBoundsException when Accept-Language is not set [#22877](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22877)
- Avoid unguarded String concatenation for debug/trace logging [#22874](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22874)
- [Regression] 404 without ACCEPT request header results in a 406 in Spring Framework 5.1.6 [#22853](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22853)
- ResourceUrlEncodingFilter throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException when %ED%B6 is in the URL path [#22851](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22851)
- MockCookie.parse(String) mishandles case sensitivity [#22786](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22786)
- WebClient fails to send POST body when ObjectMapper FLUSH_AFTER_WRITE_VALUE is false [#22771](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22771)
- More leaks related to Mono.just(dataBuffer) or Flux.just(dataBuffer) [#22754](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22754)
- Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder prevents the registration of multiple modules with a null typeId [#22740](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22740)
- ProtobufEncoder and ProtobufDecoder buffer leaks [#22731](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22731)
- o.s.h.server.reactive.ChannelSendOperator may leak the memory on cancel/error [#22720](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22720)
- EL1072E when evaluating compiled comparison expression [#22358](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22358)
- Got 404 with non-ASCII coded static resources in webflux [#22272](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22272)

- Inconsistent behavior when autowiring multiple beans by type as collection without matching beans [#22735](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22735)
- Acknowledge that HttpHeaders are case-insensitive [#22723](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22723)

- @DestinationVariable not working with RSocket support [#22776](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22776)
- Consistent non-exposure of inherited annotations in AnnotationMetadata [#22766](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22766)
- Introduce publishEvent() convenience method in TestContext [#22765](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22765)
- Add support to query if ApplicationContext is available in the TestContext framework [#22756](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22756)
- Use more efficient Reactor operators [#22727](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22727)
- Spring logging support enhancement [#22726](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22726)
- Primary resolution against FactoryBean instances [#22711](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22711)
- Expose Jaxb2Marshaller createMarshaller() and createUnmarshaller() methods [#22708](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22708)
- WebClient option with both URI template and UriBuilder [#22705](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22705)
- Track when isLazyInit has been set in AbstractBeanDefinition [#22694](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22694)
- Infer null-safety from type variables in Kotlin extensions when possible [#22687](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22687)
- RequestCondition optimizations [#22644](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22644)
- Custom WebFlux encoders/decoders are placed below defaults [#22612](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22612)
- JtaTransactionManager created with the JtaTransactionManagerFactoryBean is not ready to use [#22605](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22605)
- Avoid calling other bean methods in web config [#22596](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22596)
- Allow usage of BeanNameGenerator in ImportBeanDefinitionRegistrars [#22591](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22591)
- Add public getDeclaredMethods method to ReflectionUtils [#22580](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22580)
- Cache BridgeMethodResolver results [#22579](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22579)
- Optimize StringUtils.cleanPath [#22568](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22568)
- Use less memory and try to skip more classes when processing @Configuration classes [#22563](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22563)
- Enhance support for java.time types in spring-web [#22546](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22546)
- Migrate CacheControl to use java.time.Duration for durations [#22545](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22545)
- @RequestMapping without any attributes behaves as "default endpoint" [#22543](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22543)
- BeanFactory.get*ForAnnotation should take @Bean metadata into account [#22541](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22541)
- Revisit BeanUtils.instantiateClass to work consistently with Kotlin and Java classes [#22531](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22531)
- Use String::isEmpty instead of "".equals(arg) when arg is not null [#22502](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22502)
- CorsUtils#isCorsRequest should detect same origin requests with an Origin header [#22496](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22496)
- "java.lang.IllegalStateException: Only one connection receive subscriber allowed." is masking real exceptions in WebFlux. [#22486](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22486)
- Exclude jdk package in ShadowingClassLoader [#22485](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22485)
- Provide support for publishing test execution life-cycle events [#22477](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22477)
- Clarify configuration lite support and offer an opt-in option [#22461](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22461)
- CorsInterceptor should add to the first interceptor in InterceptorChain? [#22459](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22459)
- SpringFactoriesLoader.instantiateFactory(…) should report offending class on error [#22453](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22453)
- Minimise need to iterate over a class's methods [#22420](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22420)
- Some very simple improvements regarding usage of ArrayList [#22418](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22418)
- Extract duplicated code into a separate method [#22404](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22404)
- Simplify ConcurrentReferenceHashMap [#22387](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22387)
- MappingJackson2MessageConverter doesn't check if payload assignable to target type [#22386](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22386)
- WebClient filters should be deferred to the subscription time [#22375](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22375)
- Added configurable maxFramePayloadLength to ReactorNettyWebSocketClient [#22367](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22367)
- Avoid MimeType garbage creation [#22340](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22340)
- Use AtomicInteger instead of unsafe increment on volatile fields [#22278](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22278)
- DefaultCorsProcessor does not set "vary: Origin" if the request has no Cors header [#22273](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22273)
- Pass filename hint to the ResourceDecoder [#22267](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22267)
- Use Method in CglibAopProxy.fixedInterceptorMap instead of String returned from Method::toString [#22258](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22258)
- Add option for AbstractRequestLoggingFilter to blacklist certain headers [#22244](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22244)
- Limit ref() and provider() visibility in Kotlin DSL [SPR-17648] [#22177](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22177)
- Improve message for `HttpStatusCodeException` with empty status text [#22162](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22162)
- Add a getAttribute method to the org.springframework.ui.Model interface [SPR-17613] [#22145](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22145)
- Integrate Reactor debugging features in WebFlux  [SPR-17573] [#22105](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22105)
- Add bean definition attribute for ConfigurationClassPostProcessor to skip "lite" bean detection [SPR-17412] [#21945](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21945)
- MapMethodArgumentResolver precludes custom argument resolvers with Map and custom annotation [SPR-17340] [#21874](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21874)
- Correctly parse property name in path "map[key[foo]]" [#21855](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/21855)
- Bean registration with Kotlin DSL using callable reference with autowired parameters  [SPR-17312] [#21845](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21845)
- MockRestServiceServer.verify() not working in a CompletableFuture [SPR-17266] [#21799](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21799)
- Create replacement API for handling merged annotations [SPR-17161] [#21697](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21697)
- Use parameters declared in consumes or produces condition to narrow the request mapping [SPR-17133] [#21670](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21670)
- Introduce Servlet version HandlerFunction and RouterFunction [SPR-16952] [#21490](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21490)
- RSocket client and server support [SPR-16751] [#21292](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21292)
- Incorrect return type of Kotlin suspending functions [SPR-16515] [#21058](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21058)
- Let Spring show the URL mappings for @MessageMapping in startup process [SPR-16015] [#20564](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20564)
- Allow transaction control via Vavr Try type [SPR-15806] [#20361](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/20361)
- Add support for Kotlin coroutines [SPR-15413] [#19975](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/19975)
- Publish test execution events to the test ApplicationContext [SPR-13916] [#18490](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18490)
- toString for AbstractSqlParameterSource [#2080](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/2080)
- Open parameter autowiring utility for external use [#2060](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/2060)
- Add Kotlin DSL for working with MockMvc [#1951](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/1951)

- Improve exception handling when Hibernate-related bean creation fails [#22689](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22689)
- STOMP servers MUST handle a STOMP frame in the same manner as a CONNECT frame [#22652](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22652)
- Performance improvement in RequestMappingInfo [#22598](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22598)
- Skip more classes when processing beans in EventListenerMethodProcessor [#22564](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22564)
- Jackson2Tokenizer ignores USE_BIG_DECIMAL_FOR_FLOATS deserialization feature [#22510](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22510)
- Revisit XML schema handling for consistent local vs external resolution [#22504](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22504)
- JdbcTemplate.extractOutputParameters should preserve order of parameters [#22491](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22491)
- Lazy Session initialisation for JmsTransactionManager [#22468](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22468)
- MappingJackson2MessageConverter with Jackson Smile [#22444](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22444)
- Cannot define custom XmlFactory with Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.xml() [#22428](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22428)
- Directly registered FactoryBeans are instantiated more aggressively than those defined via `@Bean` methods [#22409](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22409)
- Provide additional debug information for memory leaks via ByteBuf.touch [SPR-17427] [#21960](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21960)
- Suppress Reactor Netty "disconnected client" exceptions the logs [SPR-17257] [#21790](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21790)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- JdbcOperationsExtensions.queryForObject overload which takes in lambda - allow null value to be returned? [#22682](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22682)
- Avoid duplicate registration of `@ControllerAdvice` implementing both RequestBodyAdvice and ResponseBodyAdvice [#22638](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22638)
- Locale inconsistently resolves to null for invalid input value [#22603](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22603)
- Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder's modulesToInstall function does not eventually override the default configuration [#22576](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22576)
- ServletWebRequest.getHeaderValues throwing NPE when header information is not available [#22547](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22547)
- Fix repeat DataBuffer#write(CharSequence, Charset) calls [#22484](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22484)
- Last-Modified Date format changed with SPR-17571 to not have double digit day [#22478](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22478)
- `@RequestMapping` content negotiation should not impact error responses formats [#22452](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22452)
- AbstractTraceInterceptor causes problems when implemented in Kotlin [#22435](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22435)
- Events extending from PayloadApplicationEvent and implementing an interface fail to match `@EventListener` argument [#22426](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22426)
- ReflectUtils.defineClass() ignores the ClassLoader argument in Java 11 [#22416](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22416)
- DefaultConversionService fails to properly convert an Object[] to a int[] [#22410](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22410)
- Ensure indexer gracefully handle missing meta annotations [#22385](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22385)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Update documentation for WebJar support [#22613](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22613)
- remove broken link "overview.html#background-ioc" in doc core.html [#22597](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/22597)
- PDF Documentation Spring-Core 5.1.5: Occurrences of a STRONG tag, where we should see a bold font [#22577](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22577)
- Using MockMvc to test Flux<ServerSentEvent> endpoints? [#22544](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22544)
- Documentation about aspectj and agent configuration is outdated and confusing [#22429](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/22429)

- DataBufferUtils does not release DataBuffer on error cases [SPR-16782] [#21322](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/21322)

:star: New Features

- SpEL Compiler: problems using primitives with instanceof operator [SPR-14250] [#18823](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18823)
- Timeout problem with Spring and Atomikos [SPR-14239] [#18812](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18812)
- Allow `@Cacheable` method to return java.util.Optional variant of cached value [SPR-14230] [#18804](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18804)
- Add get/set-IfUnmodifiedSince, get/set-IfMatch methods on HttpHeaders [SPR-14228] [#18802](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18802)
- Behavior of checkNotModified(String etag, long lastModifiedTimestamp) does not match HTTP recommendations [SPR-14224] [#18798](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18798)
- Consistent handling of multi-valued headers in HttpHeaders [SPR-14223] [#18797](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18797)
- Refactor HTTP Range support with a new ResourceRegion class [SPR-14221] [#18795](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18795)
- ServletWebRequest.isEtagNotModified does not support commas and spaces in client ETags [SPR-14216] [#18790](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18790)
- Support non-blocking receiveTimeout in AbstractPollingMessageListenerContainer [SPR-14212] [#18786](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18786)
- ScriptTemplateView can't load web-app resources [SPR-14210] [#18784](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18784)
- Support manual ACK and NACK in Stomp Client [SPR-14208] [#18782](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18782)
- HttpSessionRequiredException should have a getter for 'expected session attribute' [SPR-14206] [#18780](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18780)
- ResponseEntity should allow the usage of unassigned HTTP status codes [SPR-14205] [#18779](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18779)
- PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver should not re-resolve root URLs [SPR-14202] [#18776](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18776)
- `@RequestHeader` doesn't accept RFC-1123 for conversion to java.time.Instant [SPR-14201] [#18775](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18775)
- DefaultMessageListenerContainer doesn't shutdown gracefully if long recovery interval is set [SPR-14200] [#18774](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18774)
- Java 8 default methods not detected as bean properties [SPR-14198] [#18772](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18772)
- Add text/markdown to MediaType [SPR-14192] [#18765](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18765)
- Support test annotations on interfaces [SPR-14184] [#18755](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18755)
- Support `@BeforeTransaction` and `@AfterTransaction` on interface default methods [SPR-14183] [#18754](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18754)
- Let `@Scheduled` work with a non-void method how is possible with <task:scheduled> [SPR-14175] [#18746](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18746)
- Rename MimeType's getCharSet() to getCharset() [SPR-14172] [#18744](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18744)
- Improve failure metadata that is available from BeanInstantiationException [SPR-14166] [#18738](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18738)
- RestTemplate: Support default urlVariables at template level [SPR-14147] [#18719](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18719)
- Placeholder resolution for annotation attributes is not active by default [SPR-14140] [#18712](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18712)
- Add method to TestPropertySourceUtils to add properties files directly to the environment [SPR-14131] [#18703](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18703)
- Improve MimeTypeUtils to handle the case of only a delimiter passed [SPR-14124] [#18696](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18696)
- Unable to define empty java.util.Optional bean in spring xml [SPR-14121] [#18693](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18693)
- Possibility to configure a custom WebJarAssetLocator [SPR-14092] [#18664](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18664)
- Proper load-time weaving support for Hibernate 5 [SPR-13886] [#18459](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18459)
- AbstractAdvisorAutoProxyCreator should consistently detect package-visible methods [SPR-14174] [#17890](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17890)
- `@Scheduled` methods in `@Lazy` beans are not scheduled [SPR-12872] [#17470](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17470)
- Improve handling of missing JSF session in SessionScope [SPR-12402] [#17010](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17010)
- ScheduledAnnotationBeanPostProcessor should unregister tasks on destruction of individual beans [SPR-12216] [#16830](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16830)
- Detect LoadTimeWeaver bean when declared through `@Bean` method as well [SPR-10856] [#15483](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/15483)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- AntPathMatcher Regression for trimTokens=true [SPR-14247] [#18820](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18820)
- CharacterEncodingFilter should have an option to avoid forcing encoding on responses [SPR-14240] [#18813](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18813)
- Annotated class with `@SendToUser` overrides `@SendTo` on method [SPR-14238] [#18811](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18811)
- Regression: Handler method detection reporting ambiguous methods for explicit HEAD mapping [SPR-14182] [#18753](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18753)
- MockWebResponseBuilder can't handle null domain in cookie [SPR-14169] [#18741](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18741)
- AntPathMatcher regression in 4.3 RC1 [SPR-14141] [#18713](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18713)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Add note constrain/restriction for <task:scheduled> about method signature such as `@Scheduled` [SPR-14195] [#18768](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/18768)
- Update Testing chapter regarding avoiding false positives with JPA [SPR-9032] [#13671](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/13671)

- Document SpringClassRule and SpringMethodRule in the reference manual [SPR-13037] [#17629](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17629)
- Document AopTestUtils in the reference manual [SPR-13006] [#17598](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17598)
- Document support for generating unique names for embedded databases in the reference manual [SPR-12839] [#17437](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17437)

- Allow Collection Selection/Projection to be applied to instances of Iterable [SPR-13231] [#17822](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17822)

- Allow customizing DispatcherServlet in AbstractDispatcherServletInitializer [SPR-13222] [#17813](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17813)
- JaxbMarshaller scan should skip annotated interfaces [SPR-13221] [#17812](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17812)
- JdbcTemplate.queryForObject(sql, <primitive>.class) produces TypeMismatchDataAccessException [SPR-13220] [#17811](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17811)

- As of Jackson 2.6 the module class supporting the java.time (java8) package has changed [SPR-13212] [#17804](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17804)

- Avoid rejecting same origin requests detected as CORS requests [SPR-13206] [#17798](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17798)
- LinkedMultiValueMap should allow for deep copy of List values [SPR-13201] [#17793](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17793)
- CommonsMultipartResolver should support setFileSizeMax [SPR-13200] [#17792](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17792)
- Support HandlerMethod parameter in `@MessageExceptionHandler` [SPR-13196] [#17788](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17788)
- Add an Access-Control-Request-Method check for CORS preflight requests [SPR-13193] [#17785](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17785)
- Add a CORS Filter [SPR-13192] [#17784](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17784)
- DelegatingFilterProxy should be aware of FrameworkServlet's WebApplicationContext [SPR-13191] [#17783](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17783)
- Unresolvable class in 'basePackageClasses' annotation attribute results in misleading and hard to diagnose error [SPR-13177] [#17769](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17769)
- Add `@EventListener` value() support for event class literals [SPR-13156] [#17747](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17747)
- ScriptTemplateView configuration option for JavaScript concurrency issues [SPR-13034] [#17626](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17626)
- Reduce BeanDefinition cloning in AbstractBeanFactory.getMergedBeanDefinition [SPR-12236] [#16851](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16851)
- MultipartFile interface should extend InputStreamSource [SPR-11861] [#16480](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16480)

- SseEmitter is not thread safe [SPR-13224] [#17815](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17815)
- ResponseBodyEmitter skips same messages during initialization [SPR-13223] [#17814](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17814)
- Populate RequestAttributes before invoking FilterChain in MockMvc [SPR-13217] [#17808](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17808)
- WebContentGenerator not backwards compatible [SPR-13207] [#17799](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17799)
- NullPointerException possible in DefaultSubscriptionRegistry [SPR-13204] [#17796](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17796)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Improve Documentation about when use BindingAwareModelMap and ExtendedModelMap [SPR-12896] [#17495](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17495)

- Improve documentation for `@IfProfileValue` precedence [SPR-11902] [#16521](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16521)
- Documentation should mention `@Primary` [SPR-7301] [#11960](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/11960)
