:star: New Features

- Avoid reading (empty) RequestBody for HTTP methods that aren't expected to have a body [SPR-13176] [#17768](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17768)
- Introduce logging support for MvcResult details in the Spring MVC Test framework [SPR-13171] [#17762](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17762)
- Print cookies in human-readable form in Spring MVC Test [SPR-13168] [#17759](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17759)
- Allow MVC handler methods to return any CharSequence type as view name [SPR-13165] [#17756](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17756)
- Support inlined statements in `@Sql` in the TestContext framework [SPR-13159] [#17750](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17750)
- Allow multiple destination per `@JmsListener` [SPR-13147] [#17738](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17738)
- Add an easy way to configure custom StompSubProtocolErrorHandler for StompSubProtocolHandler. [SPR-13142] [#17733](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17733)
- Support for Jetty 9.3 [SPR-13140] [#17731](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17731)
- Status 406 "Not Accepted" is not appropriate when no message converter can handle return type [SPR-13135] [#17726](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17726)
- Allow body of JmsListener annotated method to define returned Message Destination [SPR-13133] [#17724](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17724)
- Support CompletableFuture<> as return type of `@Async` methods [SPR-13128] [#17719](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17719)
- HttpComponentsAsyncClientHttpRequestFactory overrides default request config of httpclient [SPR-13125] [#17716](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17716)
- 400 Bad Request for missing URI template variable is incorrect [SPR-13121] [#17712](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17712)
- Introduce general purpose isEmpty() method in ObjectUtils [SPR-13119] [#17710](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17710)
- Add request timeout to ResponseBodyEmitter [SPR-13104] [#17695](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17695)
- Improve circular import exception, in particular for `@Import` vs import through nesting [SPR-13101] [#17692](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17692)
- Spring does not log deserialization / marshalling errors to the console [SPR-13100] [#17691](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17691)
- Prevent class/classloader retention in GenericConversionService [SPR-13099] [#17690](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17690)
- Reduce memory consumption for caches [SPR-13093] [#17684](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17684)
- Allow annotation to be synthesized from a map with minimal attributes [SPR-13087] [#17678](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17678)
- Transaction Scope [SPR-13085] [#17676](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17676)
- Custom async HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler should work with `@ResponseBody`  [SPR-13083] [#17674](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17674)
- Introduce synthesized annotation alternative to getAnnotationAttributes() in AnnotatedElementUtils [SPR-13082] [#17673](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17673)
- Performing an asyncDispatch with MockMvc fails if DeferredResult is not yet set [SPR-13079] [#17670](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17670)
- AsyncResult implementation does not allow for throwing ExecutionException [SPR-13076] [#17668](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17668)
- Support retrieval of nested annotations in AnnotationAttributes [SPR-13074] [#17666](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17666)
- Document public API in AnnotationAttributes [SPR-13072] [#17664](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17664)
- Improve generics matching of ApplicationEvent subtypes with generic payload parameter [SPR-13069] [#17661](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17661)
- Introduce support for synthesizing AnnotationAttributes into an annotation [SPR-13067] [#17659](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17659)
- CORS global configuration support in XML namespace [SPR-13046] [#17638](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17638)
- Base64 support option without Commons Codec dependency on Java 6/7 [SPR-12938] [#17531](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17531)
- Make `@ResponseBody` method return type available to message converters [SPR-12811] [#17408](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17408)
- Maintain original ordering of active profiles in the TestContext framework [SPR-12492] [#17098](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17098)
- UriComponentsBuilder#fromHttpRequest should consider RFC-7239 Forwarded headers [SPR-11856] [#16475](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16475)
- Introduce a comprehensive programming model for meta-annotation support [SPR-11511] [#16136](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16136)
- Introduce aliases for 'value' annotation attributes [SPR-11393] [#16020](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/16020)

## :beetle: Bug Fixes

- Type aware canWrite() method should be called for GenericHttpMessageConverter [SPR-13161] [#17752](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17752)
- MimeType must use case insensitive comparisons for Charsets [SPR-13157] [#17748](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17748)
- Stomp version 1.1 and 1.2 allows headers with empty values [SPR-13111] [#17702](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17702)

- AnnotationUtils.getRepeatableAnnotation() swallows AnnotationConfigurationException [SPR-13084] [#17675](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17675)
- Server Sent Events use "event" as the type prefix [SPR-13080] [#17671](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17671)
- Nested arrays of annotations are synthesized with wrong component type [SPR-13077] [#17669](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17669)
- AnnotationUtils breaks contract for `@Repeatable` annotations [SPR-13068] [#17660](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17660)
- XpathResultMatchers ignores character encoding of XML document [SPR-12676] [#17275](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17275)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Documentation definition for ConditionalGenericConverter not the same as the source definition [SPR-13071] [#17663](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17663)
- Add description of Closeable and AutoCloseable in reference document [SPR-13041] [#17633](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/17633)
